name: tetris
title: Tetris Background
description: A dark grid of thin-bordered cells covering the background. One indigo square drops a row at a time, one column at a time, and clicking a filled cell deletes it; full bottom rows clear.
use: A developer or gaming site that wants a quietly moving grid backdrop behind a headline, no gameplay.
avoid: The cells are clickable only one by one, the whole grid is decorative, and it re-randomises on every resize.
a11y: Falling cells are plain divs with onClick, so they cannot be reached or cleared from the keyboard, and the looping drop has no reduced-motion pause. (keyboard: no, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A full-bleed grid of square cells drawn with thin slate-blue borders on a near-black base, evenly spaced across the whole stage. A few cells are filled with a translucent indigo square, and here and there these line up into short vertical columns. Faint white text sits centre.
behaves: Once a second a new block appears at a random column in the top row and every block falls one cell downward, so columns build and eventually reach the bottom. A completely filled bottom row empties, and clicking a filled cell clears it.
customise: Set the square colour and the number of columns through props; the fall speed (one second), cell borders and shade ramp are fixed in the source.
weight: light: A grid of divs updated once a second by an interval; no per-frame render loop.
